info.title: campus-api-gateway
info.description: Public gateway: health, published school pages and optional admission enquiries. Identity, student and internal receiver paths are not routed. Routes require exact paths without query strings or trailing slashes. Generic limits apply to all requests; one process with in-memory counters is currently supported. Enquiries are implemented in PR #2, merged 3 November 2026. Optional authenticated core school-profile routing uses the common limiter and a private mTLS upstream; login/auth routes are still closed.

post.description: Feature PR #2, merged 3 November 2026. Anonymous public submission with adult declaration and contact consent. Origin must exactly equal PUBLIC_ORIGIN; browser supplies it. Exact application/json; no Content-Encoding or Expect; max 8 KiB and three-second body deadline. Idempotency UUID is lowercased by gateway. Additional submission limits apply. Returns 503 if enquiry routing is not configured. No enquiry reading/listing endpoint is public.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable UUID for one submission; same normalized payload returns the same receipt, different payload returns 409. Private receiver expects lowercase.

phone.description: Indian mobile: 10 digits starting 6–9 or +91 prefix; spaces, parentheses and hyphens stripped.

email.description: Optional; empty accepted, otherwise a valid email address, normalized lowercase.

message.description: Optional text, trimmed with CRLF normalized to LF. Tabs and line breaks accepted; other control characters rejected. Text is stored privately, not rendered as HTML.

get.summary: Read the selected school through the common gateway
get.description: Optional route requiring complete CORE_API_ORIGIN and CORE_TLS_*_FILE configuration. GET only; no HEAD alias. The common socket-network, school-selector and global budgets run before backend calls. Forward exactly one __Host-campus_session cookie over private TLS 1.3 to core /v1/schools/{tenantId}; verify core CA, hostname and exact service URI. No direct identity call or authorization cache at the gateway: core checks current identity and school permissions. Strip browser identity/forwarding headers and unrelated cookies. Reject body, query, bearer credential or ambiguous cookies. Canned denials prevent leaking upstream diagnostics. External browser-facing HTTPS and private network deployment remain operational requirements. Login routes remain unavailable; separate teacher review and guardian progress reads are documented.

get.summary: Read pending reviews for an assigned teacher
get.description: Uses existing optional CORE_API_ORIGIN/CORE_TLS_* configuration, common gateway limits and upstream concurrency. No gateway-to-identity fanout. Only the session cookie is forwarded over mTLS to core; identity/forwarding headers are stripped. Validate exact metadata schema, matching tenant/assignment/queue, ordered pages and a 64KiB response bound. GET only, no HEAD alias or request body. queue is required; limit defaults to 25 (maximum 100), with optional afterId. Reject duplicate/unknown/empty query fields, percent encodings, fragments and noncanonical UUIDs/numbers. Requires a fresh identity decision for core.teacher-review-queue.read.v1 / learning.review_queue_read and a current staff binding matching BOTH user and membership in the selected tenant. Core requires active linked school, staff, assignment and academic year. Guardian bindings and school.read alone grant no access. Cursor remains valid after processing its row, but must belong to the requested original section/year and queue. Return metadata only, never lesson/submission/feedback content. One REPEATABLE READ snapshot and atomic actor audit; access already admitted may finish after revocation. No authorization cache or retry. Browser HTTPS and private network deployment remain operational requirements; synthetic harness is not a browser login flow.

get.summary: Read learning progress for a linked child
get.description: Uses the existing core mTLS client and common core:<tenantId> limiter/concurrency budget. Only the session cookie is forwarded; gateway does not call identity. Exact metadata schema, school/enrolment/date binding, counts and array bounds are validated; response limit is 512 KiB. GET only; no HEAD alias or body. Both dates are required; reject unknown, duplicate, empty or percent-encoded query values. Requires fresh core.guardian-progress.read.v1 / learning.guardian_progress_read authorization, matching both identity user and membership to an active guardian binding and an active guardian/student relationship. Teacher bindings, school.read and teacher review permissions do not grant this access. School must be active and linked; guardian active; student registered. Enrolment may be active, withdrawn or completed, and the original year active or closed. Draft years, planned/cancelled enrolments and inactive students are denied. History preserves original enrolment/year and recorded sections. A 1–31-day report is bounded to 200 homework records, 31 catch-up packs and 20 lesson/20 homework references per pack; exceeding a cap returns 422, never silent truncation. Response contains metadata, explicit unmarked attendance and current completion/revision status; no names, evidence, guidance or feedback. One REPEATABLE READ snapshot and atomic verified-user access audit; decision expiry checked after DB acquisition. An admitted read may finish after a concurrent revocation. No authorization cache, retry or mutation.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Real calendar date. Inclusive range is 1–31 days, within the enrolment academic year; year 0000 is rejected.
